scope.base_mode_behavior: All abbreviation, connective, TAIL, quick-slot, and Latin-gate processing is disabled in BASE.

categories.basic_word: 접속어 목록과 TAIL에 속하지 않는 일반 단어. 초성·종성 혼합 허용.
categories.connective: 사용자가 확정한 55개 접속/연결 조각. 최대한 초성 중심, 세로 충돌 때 종성 최소 사용.
categories.tail: 앞말에 공백 없이 붙는 말의 끝. 최대한 오른손 종성 중심.
categories.quick: 프로젝트별 인명·지명·조직명 등을 위한 비어 있는 12개 동적 매크로 슬롯.

scope.single_syllable_policy: 한 음절 단어는 약어 사전에 등록하지 않는다.

priority: ABBR + exactly one vowel => quick slot
ABBR + exactly one physical alphabet key => momentary Latin gate
normal STENO chord when any vowel is present

repeat_selectors.CHO_DOUBLE: 접속어/왼손 WORD의 실제 쌍초 또는 반복 자음 표식
repeat_selectors.JONG_DOUBLE: TAIL/일반 WORD의 실제 쌍종 또는 반복 자음 표식
repeat_selectors.AB2: 쌍모음키가 모음 없는 자음 약어에서 추가 사전 은행 또는 반복 예외 표식으로 작동

latin_gate.trigger: Hold ABBR_L or ABBR_R and finish with exactly one physical A-Z key.
latin_gate.key_interpretation: physical QWERTY key, not Korean logical role
latin_gate.first_key_resolution: Resolve on release or after chord disambiguation; if another chord key joins, cancel Latin output and perform abbreviation lookup.
latin_gate.hold_behavior: After Latin gate is entered, further A-Z keys are emitted immediately until the owning abbreviation key is released.
latin_gate.release_behavior: Return to Korean STENO input state.

forced_uppercase.note: Do not blindly send Shift when Caps Lock is on, because standard hosts invert case.

latin_gate.reserved_patterns: ABBR_L/ABBR_R + one consonant only may not be assigned to a normal abbreviation.
latin_gate.multikey_unregistered: no output; abbreviation-key tap action is also cancelled

reserved_physical_chords.note: Number and other reserved chords must be exact-mask checked before normal abbreviation fallback.

QMK_Vial.recommended: Use a custom STENO exact-mask state machine for the fixed dictionaries. Map the 12 quick masks to dynamic macro IDs M0-M11.
QMK_Vial.configuration: Set DYNAMIC_KEYMAP_MACRO_COUNT (or the corresponding Vial setting in the fork) to at least 12.
QMK_Vial.editor: Use the existing Vial Macro page to edit only M0-M11; no custom abbreviation settings page is required for quick slots.
QMK_Vial.combo_only: QMK Combo + Macro can reproduce simple/medium fixed chords and the 2-key quick slots. It is not a clean replacement for the full engine because of exact-mask no-output, dual-role vowels, mode exit, direct correction, and Latin-gate arbitration.
QMK_Vial.combo_release_note: COMBO_NO_TIMER can activate combos on the first key release, but this does not by itself implement the complete state machine.

ZMK.recommended: Use a custom behavior/module for the full engine, or ZMK combos that invoke macro behaviors for a smaller fixed subset.
ZMK.quick_slots: Define quick_0 through quick_11 macro behaviors and trigger them from the 12 quick combos.
ZMK.editing: Macro bodies can be edited in source/keymap tools and rebuilt. Do not assume that every ZMK Studio setup can edit arbitrary macro bodies at runtime; verify the exact Studio/module capabilities.
ZMK.combo_macro: ZMK combos can invoke macro behaviors, so a fixed similar-STENO subset is possible without a separate custom editor.

generic_firmware.recommended_result: output Korean text by the stored dubeolsik_keys while the host IME is Korean
generic_firmware.spacing: No entry inserts a leading or trailing space unless its output text explicitly contains one.

source_basis.conversation: User-confirmed design rules and mappings from the KLOR/Cornix STENO design conversation.
